Selkie Warden · уровень 3

As a Bonus Action, you can Slip the Skin to partially assume a selkie form for 1 minute:
• You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
• Opportunity attacks against you are made with Disadvantage.
• You can move through Enemy spaces without treating them as Difficult Terrain.
You can use Slip the Skin a number of times equal to your
Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Автоматизация / ограничения:

  • Активация эффекта и расход — макрос управления.

source.custom: Legends of the Round Table: Chivalric Handbook
